text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower has an upcoming photo
shoot to
help show off her signature
racewear. We're
discussing the details of
the shoot when...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! S-sorry!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's something that's been
on my
mind about the upcoming shoot...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon is taking part in it too, so
yesterday I
asked her what her vision for
her photo shoot is.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A CG background with lighting that
mimics the
feeling of being in outer
space. Also, special
effects that
accentuate the structure of my
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will use poses and camera angles to
make it look
like I am floating. I
composed layouts to use on
the day of
the shoot based on 3D model samples
I
received from the crew.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is how I will express the concept for
my
signature racewear: "A high-speed
battle cruiser
flying through space."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
All procedures to "describe plans for
photo
shoot" complete.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-wow! Your plan sounds amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your kind words are appreciated. I hope
I was
able to provide inspiration for you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon has thought out her plan for
the shoot in
meticulous detail.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I think it's really cool how she put so
much
passion into her idea, but at the
same time...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It made me realize that I didn't even
think of a
concept for my shoot.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was so overjoyed to have photos taken
of me in
my wonderful racewear that I
didn't consider
anything beyond that...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We lay out the design for Nishino
Flower's
signature racewear on the table.
There's bound to
be something we can
use for the shoot in here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, an idea hits me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The motif? Well, that's pretty simple...
It's
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I wanted the design of my racewear to
reflect
both my dreams and desires.
Flowers were the
first thing that came to
mind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just as a bud will someday bloom
elegantly... I
want to eventually blossom
into a wonderful
grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! I think I get it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My dreams and desires... They're the
concept of
my racewear! Then that
means...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the day of the photo shoot
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Hold that pose! Love that natural
smile! That
bouquet is the perfect prop
to match your flower
motif!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That radiant expression is superb!
That's a
keeper right there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower turns the studio into a
stunning
garden, and the photos
successfully capture her
emotions and
brilliant smile.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The colors? Well, the yellow really
pops... And
the purple makes a nice
contrast.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to put my heart and soul into
my
racewear, and I thought I could
convey that with
the colors.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yellow represents vibrant energy, while
this
purple has a grown-up air to it...
Each color
symbolizes an aspect of my
ideal future self.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, this is just a thought, but maybe I
can do the
shoot with a bento box!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I think my feelings will come across
better in
photos featuring my racewear
alongside colorful
foods.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, maybe that's too weird.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I really feel like that will be able to
capture her
personality and nature
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the day of the photo shoot
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Here's to a good shoot today.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, the way the afternoon light draws
out the
colors in your racewear and that
lovely bento
box... You look wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower spreads out the colorful
lunch she
made herself and poses for the
camera.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I put my heart and soul into making this
food!
Please take plenty of great
pictures of it with my
outfit!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Wowza! What an abundance of vibrant
hues!
They're really going to bring out
your smile in
these pics!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's idea helps bring out her
charm in
spades, and she earns the
photographer's seal of
approval. The
final photos successfully capture
her
brilliant smile.
